blocks.content: A notification policy routes alerts that match specific labels to a contact point you choose. In this milestone you create a new child policy under the default policy.
To create a notification policy, complete the following steps:

On the **Notification policies** page, click **+ New child policy** under the Default policy.

A configuration panel opens where you define label matchers and select a contact point.

Add **label matchers** that determine which alerts this policy handles.

Click **Add matcher** and enter a label, operator, and value.

For example:

| Label | Operator | Value | Effect |
|-------|----------|-------|--------|
| severity | = | critical | Matches alerts labeled severity=critical |
| team | = | platform | Matches alerts labeled team=platform |

Select a **contact point** for this policy.

All alerts that match the label matchers you defined will be sent to this destination.

For example, send critical alerts to a PagerDuty integration and warning alerts to a Slack channel.

Click **Save policy** to create the new child policy.

The policy now appears in the tree under the Default policy. Alerts with matching labels will route to the contact point you selected.
In the next milestone, you will configure how alerts are grouped in this policy.
